nativeGroups.readOrder: Copy an extensible mix format verbatim; for a non-extensible format retain its base fields and fill extensible size/valid bits, derived speaker mask and IEEE-float subtype.

Obtain and normalize endpoint mix format. Keep a matching requested channel count, or try the requested layout through shared-mode format support; a closest response or rejection falls back to normalized mix/closest channels. Unsupported anonymous channel counts retain an anonymous configuration. Free returned COM format allocations natively.
Return the conventional speaker mask for channel counts one through eight, otherwise zero. Packed configuration construction is now inline in the selector caller, separately from this scalar helper.

If sink state is valid and current-padding query succeeds, compute whole available quanta from device capacity minus padding and frame/resampler capacity; optionally restrict by ring occupancy. Return success with the count, including zero when full. Invalid state or failed padding query returns failure without an admitted count.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected installed triplet, current voice-owned sink constructor/service extents, complete current format reader/selector and available-frame groups, fully covered scalar speaker-mask leaf, its bounded channel table, checked interface GUID loads and COM call operands.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Current negotiation obtains and normalizes mix format, tests requested channels and selects mix/closest fallback. Both normalization and selection call the same scalar speaker-mask helper; packed channel configuration is constructed inline in selection. Current service setup retains optional client/session settings, timing and rate conversion/fallback branches, render service acquisition and initial silence release. Available-frame computation reads capacity/padding and optional ring occupancy under its checked state guards.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Opaque output/plugin contexts and cached format state remain stored layouts; COM interface identity is bound by checked GUID bytes and slot calls.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Valid sink/object state and endpoint-provided format, interface, timing and HRESULT responses select these branches. Historical finite COM/native negotiation cohorts were not rerun or promoted by this static port.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Current executed negotiation/parity, game-selected endpoint/output identity, actual OS/device acceptance and scheduling, continuous native resampling, concurrent lifetime/teardown and audibility.
